prompt: Create ONE landscape 16:9 static classroom teaching diagram in graphic-novel screenprint style. Market and interval identifiers → validated price records → filtered comparison. Visually distinguish missing values from zero. The conceptual steps supplied by the UI are: Define the comparison: select the market, period and measurement needed. | Organize the records: time, location and units belong with every value. | Prepare comparable data: missing records and different intervals can distort a comparison. | Ask a bounded question: a filtered result supports an analysis, not a guaranteed forecast. GRAPHIC-NOVEL / limited-colour SCREENPRINT. Confident forest-green ink contours (#1b3b19), mature expressive fictional adults, flat sage and ivory (#faf9f7) colour planes, natural skin and hair, bold silhouettes, coarse halftone shadows, fine crosshatching, textured uncoated paper and restrained burnt-orange/slate-blue accents. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not pixel art. Anatomically coherent hands attached to visible arms; no floating limbs, no logos, no watermark. Prioritize a SIMPLE accurate scientific or process relationship, generous ivory negative space. Explicit arrowheads show causal direction; at most four small forest-green circular markers numbered 1, 2, 3, 4. No other text, no long labels, no title, no brand, no caption strip. No invented statistics or precision. Labels/explanations will be live HTML outside this artwork. For data and business diagrams use clearly schematic fictional records and shapes, avoid tiny pseudo-text. For medical/scientific diagrams avoid depicting a clinical procedure. No distracting human figures unless necessary to the specified mechanism.
